Simplified vs VEXI: Campaigns or Your Whole Social Media?
Simplified sells AI agents that turn a brief into a campaign of posts for you to approve. VEXI also edits your own footage and makes long-form video.
Simplified briefs AI agents to make your campaigns. Here is how it compares with one app built around your own footage and your own business.

Simplified sells AI agents for marketing. You brief them in plain language, and they produce the design, write the copy and assemble the campaign; nothing ships until you approve it. A campaign is one batch: 6 social posts, an email sequence or a set of ad creatives. Every plan includes social scheduling and AI videos. Starter is listed at $59 to $79 a month (its pricing page shows both), Pro at $99 to $119 and Business at $199 to $239, with 5, 15 and 40 campaigns a month.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Simplified's brief, review and ship model is close to how VEXI works. The difference is the footage and the rhythm. Simplified works in campaigns, a set number a month, each one starting from your brief, and its pages do not describe editing the videos you filmed. VEXI edits your own clips with B-roll, music and captions, makes long-form video, and Autopilot keeps the week going. VEXI costs more than Simplified: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
